title: Neighborhood BBQ – This Saturday
summary: Join us at the park for food, music, and kid activities.
content: We’re hosting a community BBQ at the park this Saturday from 4–7 PM. Bring a lawn chair, a side dish if you’d like, and come ready to meet neighbors!

title: HOA Meeting – August 21st
content: The HOA meeting will be held at the clubhouse on August 21st at 7 PM. Agenda includes budget review, landscaping updates, and fall event planning.

title: Pool Maintenance Schedule
content: The neighborhood pool will be closed August 2–3 for deep cleaning and chemical treatment. We appreciate your understanding.
